source_message.text: More context: I am specifically targeted folks looking for estate planning services (as opposed to other estate law services like estate administration, probate, elder law, etc). Got kind of confused when I saw this forecast suggest that I'd see a sharp drop off in ROAS when spending $2,000 or more. Felt weird that I could only squeeze out 20 monthly form fills (and maybe 3 conversions) when targeting a pretty large geographic area (all of New Jersey, and the affluent Philly suburb counties). But maybe that's the limit? Maybe the forecast tool isn't accurate pre-campaign launch? Once, you'd have a chance to look let me know what is even possible to know at this point.
